title: RTC Fact Sheet: 2025 State of Evictions
text:
Code
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(flextable)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(socratadata)
library(lubridate)
library(writexl)

# Ensure that the Quarto render and RStudio read the same environment vars
readRenviron(".Renviron")

con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  dbname = Sys.getenv("PG_DBNAME"),
  host     = Sys.getenv("PG_HOST"),
  port     = Sys.getenv("PG_PORT"),
  user     = Sys.getenv("PG_USER"),
  password = Sys.getenv("PG_PASSWORD")
  )
The following analyses were performed in support of Right to Counsel’s annual State of Evictions fact sheet.
Code
# First, pull data. Then, work locally in R.

### Evictions db SQL queries ###

# Eviction Filings, 2020 - 2025, all
filings_20_25 <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), fileddate, court
  FROM oca_index i
  WHERE i.fileddate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) 
      AND i.fileddate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31)
      AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment')
      AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL);
")

# Eviction Filings, 2020 - 2025, with location
filings_20_25_sf <- st_read(con, query = "
  SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), fileddate, court,
    ST_Transform(a.geom, 2263) AS geom
  FROM oca_index i
  JOIN oca_addresses a ON i.indexnumberid = a.indexnumberid
  WHERE i.fileddate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) 
      AND i.fileddate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31)
      AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment')
      AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL)
      AND a.geom IS NOT NULL;
")

# Executed Evictions, 2020 - 2025, all
executions_20_25 <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), w.executiondate, i.court
  FROM oca_index i
  JOIN oca_warrants w ON i.indexnumberid = w.indexnumberid
  WHERE w.executiondate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) 
    AND w.executiondate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31)
    AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment')
    AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL)
    AND w.executiondate IS NOT NULL;
")

# Executed Evictions, 2020 - 2025, with location
executions_20_25_sf <- st_read(con, query = "
  WITH executed_evictions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), w.executiondate, i.court
    FROM oca_index i
    JOIN oca_warrants w ON i.indexnumberid = w.indexnumberid
    WHERE w.executiondate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) 
      AND w.executiondate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31)
      AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment')
      AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL)
      AND w.executiondate IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT e.*, ST_TRANSFORM(a.geom, 2263)
  FROM executed_evictions e
  JOIN oca_addresses a on e.indexnumberid = a.indexnumberid
  WHERE a.geom IS NOT NULL
")

### Boundary Files ###
# NYC Boundary via borough boundary union
nyc <- read_sf("https://services5.arcgis.com/GfwWNkhOj9bNBqoJ/arcgis/rest/services/NYC_Borough_Boundary/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=pgeojson") |> 
  st_transform(2263) |> 
  st_make_valid() |> 
  st_union()

# NYS Assembly
nysad <- read_sf("https://services6.arcgis.com/EbVsqZ18sv1kVJ3k/ArcGIS/rest/services/NYS_Assembly_Districts/FeatureServer/0/query?where=0%3D0&outFields=*&f=geojson") |> 
  st_transform(2263) |> 
  st_make_valid()

# NYS Senate
nyss <- read_sf("https://services6.arcgis.com/EbVsqZ18sv1kVJ3k/ArcGIS/rest/services/NYS_Senate_Districts/FeatureServer/0/query?where=0%3D0&outFields=*&f=geojson") |> 
  st_transform(2263) |> 
  st_make_valid()

# NYC Council
nyc_council <- read_sf("https://services5.arcgis.com/GfwWNkhOj9bNBqoJ/arcgis/rest/services/NYC_City_Council_Districts/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=pgeojson") |> 
  st_transform(2263) |> 
  st_make_valid()

# NYC Council members
nyc_council_members <- soc_read(
  "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/City-Government/City-Council-Members-1999-to-Present-/uvw5-9znb.json"
) |> 
  # Filter to current term
  filter(Sys.Date() %within% interval(start = term_start, end = term_end))

# Join CMs to spatial file
nyc_council <- nyc_council |> 
  left_join(nyc_council_members |> 
              select(name, district),
            by = join_by(CounDist == district)) |> 
  # Designate Vacant seats
  mutate(name = replace_na(name, "Vacant"))

# NYC Boundaries via Borough union
bb <- read_sf("https://services5.arcgis.com/GfwWNkhOj9bNBqoJ/arcgis/rest/services/NYC_Borough_Boundary/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=pgeojson") |> 
  st_transform(2263) |> 
  st_make_valid() |> 
  st_union()

# NYS Counties
nys_counties <- read_sf("https://services6.arcgis.com/EbVsqZ18sv1kVJ3k/ArcGIS/rest/services/NYS_Civil_Boundaries/FeatureServer/2/query?where=0%3D0&outFields=*&f=geojson") |> 
  st_transform(2263)

# Separate out upstate / downstate
nysad_downstate <- st_filter(nysad, bb, .predicate = st_intersects)

nysad_upstate <- st_filter(nysad, bb, .predicate = st_disjoint)

nyss_downstate <- st_filter(nyss, bb, .predicate = st_intersects)
  
nyss_upstate <- st_filter(nyss, bb, .predicate = st_disjoint)

title: RTC Fact Sheet: 2025 State of Evictions
text:
Cumulative Eviction Filings

Number of eviction filings from January 1, 2020 - December 31, 2025
In New York State, there were 849,786 eviction-oriented (holdover and non-payment) filings from January 1, 2020 to December 31, 2025.
Please note that this analysis excludes commercial evictions within New York City. Unfortunately, outside of NYC, excluding commercial from residential eviction filings and executions is not possible given the current data.
